sections.Profile:
The "Double-Feature" pinball machine, released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in December 1950, is a single-player, electro-mechanical game designed by Wayne Neyens, with artwork by Roy Parker.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1950
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
